# Upgrading to 0.4.2

<!-- upgrade-from: v0.4.1 -->

Security patch release for dependencies: no database migration, binding or API change. From 0.4.0, first apply the
[0.4.1 upgrade](0.4.1.md).

Bump the `@castra-kit/*` packages to `0.4.2` and the dev tooling below, then run `pnpm install`. Run `pnpm update`
as well so the transitive `undici`, `fast-uri`, `body-parser`, `ip-address` and `qs` resolve to patched versions;
`pnpm audit` should then be clean apart from tooling that has no fix upstream yet.
